how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and guidelines from the district website (balangir.odisha.gov.in) or the OAV Kursud website (oav.edu.in/OAVKUR), or collect it in person from the Office of the Principal, OAV Kursud, between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM on working days.
Fill in the application form completely and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents.

Place the filled-in application and documents in a sealed envelope, super-scribed: "APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF SUPPORT STAFF FOR BOYS' HOSTEL, OAV KURSUD", along with the name of the post applied for.
Send the sealed envelope through Speed Post/Registered Post, or submit it by hand, to the address below.
Ensure the application reaches the office within the submission window: 25-08-2026 to 08-09-2026, between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM.
The Principal Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Kursud At/Po-Kursud, Block-Titilagarh Dist-Balangir, Odisha-767035
important_instructions: Incomplete applications, or applications received after the last date, will be summarily rejected. The authority reserves the right to cancel the engagement process at any stage without assigning any reason. This is a purely temporary/contractual engagement and does not confer any right to regular appointment. Only candidates residing in Titilagarh Block/Balangir District are eligible; candidates from other districts should not apply.

content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any category-wise (SC/ST/OBC/SEBC/UR) reservation breakup for these vacancies, though the application form does ask candidates to state their category.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for OAV Kursud Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: As per the checklist attached to the application form, candidates must submit self-attested photocopies of the following documents along with the filled-in application: HSC Certificate & Mark Sheet +2 Certificate & Mark Sheet BA/BSc Certificate & Mark Sheet Caste Certificate Aadhaar Card Residence Certificate Certificate of Experience in Hostel Management (if applicable) Self-attested passport-size photographs The application form also requires: a recent passport-size photograph, full name, father's name, date of birth, gender, religion, category (SC/ST/OBC/SEBC/UR), permanent address with PIN code, mobile number, WhatsApp number, email ID, and educational qualification details (examination passed, board/university, year of passing, marks obtained, percentage, and division).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OAV Kursud Boys' Hostel Support Staff Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the prescribed application form and guidelines from the district website ( balangir.odisha.gov.in ) or the OAV Kursud website ( oav.edu.in/OAVKUR ), or collect it in person from the Office of the Principal, OAV Kursud, between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM on working days. Fill in the application form completely and attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents. Place the filled-in application and documents in a sealed envelope, super-scribed: "APPLICATION FOR ENGAGEMENT OF SUPPORT STAFF FOR BOYS' HOSTEL, OAV KURSUD" , along with the name of the post applied for. Send the sealed envelope through Speed Post/Registered Post, or submit it by hand, to the address below. Ensure the application reaches the office within the submission window: 25-08-2026 to 08-09-2026 , between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. The Principal Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Kursud At/Po-Kursud, Block-Titilagarh Dist-Balangir, Odisha-767035

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications for the OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026 is 08 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post or submit it in person.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts advertised in OAV Balangir Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertised posts are Warden, Head Cook, Assistant Cook, and Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper for the hostel of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Titlagarh.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any specific eligibility for male candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, male candidates are specifically required for the hostel application, as mentioned in the eligibility criteria.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for all the advertised posts is 10th pass.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Balangir, which is https://balangir.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q7. How should I send my application?
faq.answer: Completed applications should be sent by Registered Post / Speed Post to Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Titlagarh, or submitted at the school on working days.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya located for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the hostel of Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya, Titlagarh, located in Balangir district, Odisha.

faq.answer: For any further queries, it is recommended to carefully read the official notification PDF and visit the official website for any updates or clarifications.
